backend/main.mo: Main backend actor managing user access control, storage mixins, profiles, stats, availability, logs, and query APIs like getCallerAvailableDaysWithLogs.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected frontend files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: List of short summaries for major frontend files describing their responsibilities across routing, hooks, pages, UI components, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables, dark mode overrides, and base element styling.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file providing the root div and loading the main frontend entry script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Top-level React app configuring routing, authentication gating, profile setup flow, and main layout wrapping all pages.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: UI screen shown when a user without permission attempts to access restricted admin pages.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginScreen: Login screen with full-screen background, branding, and Internet Identity sign-in button.
frontend/src/components/branding/AppLogo: Simple component rendering the app logo from branding config.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatPanel.t: Renders a group chat panel with message loading, scrolling, and sending support using hooks and UI components.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout with top bar, navigation, content area, and footer.
frontend/src/components/layout/Navigatio: Displays navigation buttons with icons and optional admin link based on user role.
frontend/src/components/layout/TopBar.ts: Renders the top bar with app branding, theme toggle, user avatar, and logout menu.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileC: Shows and edits the user profile, including name and profile picture upload with validation and progress.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileL: Displays the user’s ranks across weekly, monthly, and all-time leaderboards with loading states.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileM: Shows the user's match history with wins and losses, including loading and empty states.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileS: Modal prompting new users to enter their name and save their profile.
frontend/src/components/theme/Background: Provides a background image layer behind the app content.
Displays a user avatar with initials fallback and name text with size options.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Fetches and updates the caller's user profile using the actor, with query invalidation on save.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserRole.ts: Retrieves the caller's user role and admin status via actor-backed queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication state, login, logout, and identity persistence via a React context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps various backend queries and mutations for profiles, availability, stats, and history using the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Manages light/dark theme state synced with localStorage and document classes.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserDirectory.ts: Builds user directory data (names and avatars) from principals using backend profiles.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports centralized branding constants including app name and logo info.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Utility functions for converting, formatting, and comparing dates and custom day IDs.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AddAvailabilityPage.t: Form page for adding or editing a user's daily availability, including time selection and notes, with data prefill and submission logic.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard for viewing and deleting users and availabilities, with directory lookup and sorted listings.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarMonthPage.tsx: Monthly calendar view that highlights days with availability and links to daily detail pages, plus a chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.tsx: Standalone page rendering the group chat panel.
frontend/src/pages/DayDetailPage.tsx: Shows all user availabilities for a specific day with edit and delete options for the current user.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardPage.tsx: Leaderboard with time-filtered rankings and UI to record wins or losses for days the user is available.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: User profile page showing basic info, leaderboard ranks, and recent match history.
frontend/src/utils/file.ts: Utility functions for converting files to Uint8Array and generating name initials for fallback avatars.
frontend/src/utils/time.ts: Provides utilities for generating time selection options and parsing/formatting 12-hour time strings.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Handles reading, persisting, and clearing URL and sessionStorage parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures TailwindCSS theme, colors, animations, plugins, and content paths for the frontend.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, existing features, and pending requests related to Profile tab UI updates and Match History functionality.
